# Third-party: console-v2-audit (slot 243)

No dependency added and no code copied. Research only (see `docs/console/v2-plan.md`, research table):
- maud 0.27.0, MIT OR Apache-2.0, https://github.com/lambda-fairy/maud - candidate templating fallback.
- askama 0.16.1, MIT OR Apache-2.0, https://github.com/askama-rs/askama - considered.
- miniz_oxide 0.9.1, MIT OR Zlib OR Apache-2.0, https://github.com/Frommi/miniz_oxide - proposed for HTML gzip (ruling R4).
- htmx (0BSD), datastar (MIT) - not used (zero-JS console); fixi - no licence file, not allowed.
